Title: Users see failures when querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query

User impact: Users see failures when querying the Microsoft Graph Attack Simulation Training API with $Select OData query.

More info: The issue is specifically happening when using "$Select" as part of the query.

Affected users can bypass the issue by not using "$Select" in the queries. 

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.
